subject.title: fix(gateway): defer pre-ready startup maintenance in fast mode

question: Should OpenClaw core accept an opt-in `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_FAST_CONFIG=1` mode that allows Gateway startup to proceed before channel startup maintenance and startup session migration have settled?
rationale: Repository policy treats new env surfaces, startup ordering, and session-state migration timing as compatibility-sensitive, and no maintainer has confirmed this readiness tradeoff as a product direction.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this PR now and invite a maintainer-sponsored follow-up if the fast startup/readiness contract is wanted.

options.title: Sponsor the fast mode
options.body: A gateway owner can reopen or ask for a refreshed PR with explicit acceptance of the readiness and session-migration tradeoff plus `/readyz` upgrade proof.

options.title: Redesign as profiling only
options.body: Ask for a narrower diagnostics or benchmark change that measures startup cost without changing readiness or migration ordering.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR now and invite a maintainer-sponsored follow-up if the fast startup/readiness contract is wanted.

likelyOwner.reason: The central product choice is in the gateway startup seam that `gumadeiras` introduced and is the clearest routing point from the available history.
